# Forward Story v3 — Start Here

**[Open the one-page Start Here hub](https://proxima-j.github.io/stray-kitty-presentation/templates/)** to preview the reusable template, browse its workflow and copy a Codex starting prompt.

The independent starter lives in **[forward-story-v3/](forward-story-v3/)**, with two entry modes:

- [**Blank Canvas (recommended)**](forward-story-v3/blank.html) — two minimal blank scenes with the original 4.2s transitions and element reveals. Route/traveler and the visual identity are optional.
- [**Five-page Example Mode**](forward-story-v3/index.html) — existing editable compositions and visible original route/traveler.

Both reuse the same engine, media and CSS files. Copy the entire folder into a new repository. For Blank Canvas, replace only the **new copy's** `index.html` with `blank.html`. The package README, WORKFLOW.md, SCENE-RECIPES.md and ARCHITECTURE.md explain setup, design decisions and integration.

This is not a third live Stray Kitty deck. It is reusable generic source material. Current and Previous remain independent working presentations.
